atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: Inlines another stylesheet. Tailwind v4 extends it with `theme(...)`, `prefix(...)` and `source(...)` options.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines the project's design tokens (colors, fonts, breakpoints, …) as CSS variables that Tailwind turns into utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Registers extra files for Tailwind's class detection when they cannot be found by automatic source detection.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Declares a custom variant (e.g. `dark`, `hocus`) usable as a utility prefix.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant to styles inside your own CSS.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Registers a custom utility class that works with Tailwind's variants.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing utility classes into your own custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports a stylesheet for reference only (e.g. in a Vue `<style>` block) so `@apply` and `theme()` resolve without duplicating CSS.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Legacy (v3) directive that injects Tailwind's base, components and utilities layers. In v4 use `@import 'tailwindcss'` instead.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Standard CSS cascade layer. Tailwind also uses `base`, `components` and `utilities` layer names.
